lesson.title: Power of a Power Rule
intro: When raising a power to another power, multiply the exponents.
This works because repeated multiplication groups identical bases together.
Always multiply the exponents when a power is raised to another power.

workedExample.aiHint: When a power is raised to another power, multiply the exponents.

questions.explanation: Raise the coefficient: 2^4 = 16 and multiply exponents: x^(3×4) = x^12.
